name: ai_tooling
description: AI / local-LLM tooling: models, prompting, inference, RAG, hardware

schema.claim: the assertion itself, stated in one sentence
schema.subject: what the claim is about (a model, a tool, a method, a hardware class)
schema.condition: when it holds -- hardware, model size, context length, workload
schema.evidence: what the source offers in support: measurement, demo, reasoning, or none
schema.actionable: yes if a reader could do something differently because of it
